changelog: - Follow-up images in the UI (#3932): the shared follow-up form takes images — "Add image" or a screenshot pasted into the note (Ctrl+V) — in the sales follow-up panel and the hand-off dialog; the panel shows them as thumbnails and each history line shows the images it set (`imagesByEvent()`), all opening in the in-app lightbox. The hand-off dialog now scrolls when it is taller than the screen.

en: Add images to a follow-up or a hand-off: pick a file or paste a screenshot into the note. The new owner sees them on the lead.
tr: Takibe ve devre resim ekle: dosya seç ya da ekran görüntüsünü nota yapıştır. Yeni sahip resimleri lead'de görür.
de: Bilder zur Wiedervorlage oder Übergabe hinzufügen: Datei wählen oder Screenshot in die Notiz einfügen. Die neue Person sieht sie am Lead.
